summary: Wuphf (branded "gawkbot") is a Go multi-bot "office" orchestrator: the CLI at cmd/wuphf boots a broker (HTTP, port 7890) plus a web server (port 7891), and bots run one headless turn per incoming message. There is no one-shot coding-agent subcommand (--cmd only accepts slash commands; plain prose is rejected), so the recipe boots the office headlessly (--provider claude-code --unsafe --no-open) against a pre-onboarded runtime home, POSTs one DM to the lead bot "cos" via the broker's /messages API with the task text and the absolute task directory, and waits on the bot's /agent-stream SSE for the terminal "idle" headless_event before shutting down. With the claude-code provider each bot turn is a fresh `claude --print - --output-format stream-json --permission-mode bypassPermissions --dangerously-skip-permissions --mcp-config ...` subprocess (internal/team/headless_claude.go) that inherits the environment, so model traffic is routed by Claude Code's ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL/ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to the proxy using the Anthropic messages API. The harness hardcodes --model claude-sonnet-4-6 and --max-turns 30 for the lead bot.
dockerfile:
ARG BASE=buildpack-deps:jammy
FROM ${BASE}

ARG GO_VERSION=1.26.6
ARG NODE_VERSION=22.23.3
ARG CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION=2.1.281
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Only what the harness needs at build/run time; never touch the base image's python/node.
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl git jq xz-utils procps \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Self-contained runtimes under /opt/harness: a private Node (for the Claude Code CLI that
# wuphf shells out to per bot turn) and a private Go toolchain matching go.mod's toolchain line.
RUN set -eux; \
    arch="$(dpkg --print-architecture)"; \
    case "$arch" in \
      amd64) goarch=amd64; nodearch=x64 ;; \
      arm64) goarch=arm64; nodearch=arm64 ;; \
      *) echo "unsupported architecture: $arch" >&2; exit 1 ;; \
    esac; \
    mkdir -p /opt/harness/bin /opt/harness/node; \
    curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/v${NODE_VERSION}/node-v${NODE_VERSION}-linux-${nodearch}.tar.xz" \
      | tar -xJ -C /opt/harness/node --strip-components=1; \
    curl -fsSL "https://go.dev/dl/go${GO_VERSION}.linux-${goarch}.tar.gz" \
      | tar -xz -C /opt/harness

ENV PATH=/opt/harness/bin:/opt/harness/node/bin:$PATH

# Claude Code CLI is the per-turn runtime for the default claude-code provider (PreflightWeb requires it on PATH).
RUN npm_config_update_notifier=false npm install -g --no-fund --no-audit "@anthropic-ai/claude-code@${CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION}"

# Build the harness's own CLI from the repo source (pure Go, CGO off, as in .goreleaser.yml).
# web/dist/.gitkeep is tracked so the go:embed compiles without a web build; the broker API does not need the UI bundle.
COPY . /opt/harness/src
RUN set -eux; \
    cd /opt/harness/src; \
    CGO_ENABLED=0 GOTOOLCHAIN=auto GOFLAGS=-trimpath \
    GOPATH=/opt/harness/gopath GOMODCACHE=/opt/harness/gopath/pkg/mod GOCACHE=/opt/harness/gocache \
    /opt/harness/go/bin/go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o /opt/harness/bin/gawkbot ./cmd/wuphf; \
    rm -rf /opt/harness/gopath /opt/harness/gocache /opt/harness/go

RUN mkdir -p /out /work
run_command:
set -uo pipefail
OUT=/out; mkdir -p "$OUT"
export WUPHF_RUNTIME_HOME="${WUPHF_RUNTIME_HOME:-/tmp/wuphf-home}"
export WUPHF_BROKER_TOKEN_FILE="${WUPHF_BROKER_TOKEN_FILE:-/tmp/wuphf-broker-token}"
BROKER=http://127.0.0.1:7890
mkdir -p "$WUPHF_RUNTIME_HOME/.wuphf"
printf '{"version":1,"completed_at":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z","company_name":"harness"}\n' > "$WUPHF_RUNTIME_HOME/.wuphf/onboarded.json"
rm -f "$WUPHF_BROKER_TOKEN_FILE"
gawkbot --provider claude-code --no-open --unsafe --memory-backend none --broker-port 7890 --web-port 7891 </dev/null >"$OUT/gawkbot.log" 2>&1 &
OFFICE=$!
cleanup() { kill -TERM "${SSE:-}" "$OFFICE" 2>/dev/null; wait "$OFFICE" 2>/dev/null; cp -r "$WUPHF_RUNTIME_HOME/.wuphf/office" "$OUT/office" 2>/dev/null; cp -r "$WUPHF_RUNTIME_HOME/.wuphf/logs" "$OUT/logs" 2>/dev/null; cp -r "$WUPHF_RUNTIME_HOME/.wuphf/agent-scratch" "$OUT/agent-scratch" 2>/dev/null; return 0; }
trap cleanup EXIT
for i in $(seq 1 90); do
  if curl -sf "$BROKER/health" >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -s "$WUPHF_BROKER_TOKEN_FILE" ]; then break; fi
  kill -0 "$OFFICE" 2>/dev/null || { echo "harness: gawkbot exited before the broker came up (see $OUT/gawkbot.log)" >&2; exit 1; }
  sleep 1
done
TOKEN="$(cat "$WUPHF_BROKER_TOKEN_FILE" 2>/dev/null)"
[ -n "$TOKEN" ] || { echo "harness: broker never became healthy" >&2; exit 1; }
curl -sN "$BROKER/agent-stream/cos?token=$TOKEN" >"$OUT/cos-stream.log" 2>/dev/null &
SSE=$!
sleep 1
PROMPT="$(printf 'You are running headless inside an automated evaluation. Do all work directly in the directory %s, using absolute paths (never your scratch directory). Do not ask questions, do not wait for approval, and do not delegate to other bots; complete the task yourself with your tools, then reply with a brief summary of what you changed.\n\nTask:\n%s' "$PWD" "$TASK")"
jq -cn --arg c "$PROMPT" '{from:"you",channel:"cos__human",content:$c,tagged:["cos"]}' \
  | curl -sf -X POST "$BROKER/messages" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @- >"$OUT/post-message.json" \
  || { echo "harness: posting the task message failed" >&2; exit 1; }
DEADLINE=$(( $(date +%s) + ${WUPHF_HARNESS_TIMEOUT_SECONDS:-2700} ))
STATUS=timeout
while [ "$(date +%s)" -lt "$DEADLINE" ]; do
  if grep -q '"kind":"headless_event","type":"idle"' "$OUT/cos-stream.log" 2>/dev/null; then STATUS=idle; break; fi
  if grep -q '"kind":"headless_event","type":"error"' "$OUT/cos-stream.log" 2>/dev/null; then STATUS=error; break; fi
  kill -0 "$OFFICE" 2>/dev/null || { STATUS=died; break; }
  sleep 2
done
echo "harness: cos turn finished with status=$STATUS"
[ "$STATUS" = idle ]
notes: Verified against the source on 2026-09-23. Key facts: (1) No one-shot task CLI exists; `--cmd` only dispatches slash commands (internal/commands/dispatch.go rejects prose), so the run command drives the office over its broker HTTP API exactly as scripts/benchmark.sh and scripts/smoke-broker-restart.sh do. (2) #general is disabled by default (internal/channel/general.go generalEnabled=false), so the message is posted to the human<->cos DM slug "cos__human" (channel.DirectSlug("human","cos")), which the broker auto-creates. (3) Headless turns never run in the broker cwd; they run in <runtime_home>/.wuphf/agent-scratch/<slug> (internal/team/headless_workspace.go), so the prompt names the absolute task directory. (4) The lead bot is launched with hardcoded `--model claude-sonnet-4-6` and `--max-turns 30` (internal/team/headless_claude.go); the proxy swaps the model name but the 30-turn cap is a real ceiling; per-turn wall clock is WUPHF_OFFICE_TIMEOUT/WUPHF_TURN_TIMEOUT (Go durations). (5) `--unsafe` makes bots run with `--permission-mode bypassPermissions --dangerously-skip-permissions`; Claude Code refuses that as root unless IS_SANDBOX=1, hence that env var. (6) The claude subprocess inherits the full environment (gitexec.CleanEnv strips only GIT_* vars), so ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL/ANTHROPIC_API_KEY reach it. (7) Onboarding is skipped by seeding <runtime_home>/.wuphf/onboarded.json with completed_at (internal/onboarding/state.go Onboarded()); PreflightWeb then only requires `claude` on PATH. (8) The broker writes its bearer token to WUPHF_BROKER_TOKEN_FILE (internal/team/broker.go Start); /agent-stream/<slug>?token= streams `data: {"kind":"headless_event","type":"idle"|"error",...}` at turn end (headless_event.go emitHeadlessTerminal). (9) The bun sidecar in agent/ is optional: missing bun is logged once and ignored (bot_service_supervisor.go). (10) web/dist/.gitkeep is tracked so the go:embed compiles without building the web UI; the web port serves a fallback page but the broker API is unaffected. (11) Build unverified locally (no Go on this Mac); the Go 1.26.6, Node 22.23.3, and @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281 downloads were confirmed reachable. Exit status: 0 when cos emits idle, 1 on error/timeout/early exit; gawkbot.log, cos-stream.log, post-message.json, office receipts, and scratch dirs are copied to /out.
